discount_codes_dates_ck.name: discount_codes_dates_ck
discount_codes_dates_ck.value: expires_at IS NULL OR starts_at IS NULL OR expires_at > starts_at

discount_codes_usage_ck.name: discount_codes_usage_ck
discount_codes_usage_ck.value: usage_count >= 0 AND (usage_limit IS NULL OR usage_limit > 0)

order_items_amounts_ck.name: order_items_amounts_ck
order_items_amounts_ck.value: quantity > 0 AND unit_price_cents >= 0 AND line_subtotal_cents = unit_price_cents * quantity AND discount_amount_cents >= 0 AND line_total_cents = line_subtotal_cents - discount_amount_cents

orders_amounts_ck.name: orders_amounts_ck
orders_amounts_ck.value: subtotal_cents >= 0 AND discount_amount_cents >= 0 AND shipping_amount_cents >= 0 AND total_cents >= 0 AND total_cents = subtotal_cents - discount_amount_cents + shipping_amount_cents
